Name: (STF) Willy Sell Legendary Fish
Author: Yamaoba
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5]Now Willy Sell Legendary Fish!!﻿[/size][/b]
[size=4]Trouble to catch legendary fish? want to get legendary fish without fishing?

[/size][size=5]Now with his mod, YOU CAN!![/size]
[size=4]You can have legendary fish just by buying it at Willy. But you must have at least 2 hearts with Willy.

Below is a list of legendary fish and how many hearts needed for them:
- Angler (2 Hearts)
- Glacierfish (4 Hearts)
- Mutant Crop (5 Hearts)
- Crimsonfish (7 Hearts)
- Legend (10 Hearts, 1 in store per day)
all the values are the base value of the item x4.
(For Example: Angler is worth 900g, so Willy sell for 3600g)[/size][/font][/center]
